title: POST /api/integration/start-pairing (body, optional)
description: Parsed manually from the raw body (not in FastAPI's OpenAPI). Empty body = member pairing with the default profile of the device type. 403 when allow_pairing_via_integration is off; 404 unknown profile; 422 invalid guest fields or a guest with a parental-controls profile.

guest_expires_hours.description: Default: guest_default_hours of the house settings; maximum guest_access.max_hours.

guest_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 with offset, future, at most guest_access.max_hours ahead; precedence over hours.

guest_tags.description: Guests: area scope as a device adjustment of the rule areas (mode selected with these tags; ["*"] = all areas). Ignored with 409 rule_fixed when the guest profile fixes areas. Missing = the profile decides.

profile.description: Profile NAME (case-insensitive); null or missing = default profile (guests: the guest default profile).

owner_label.description: Owner label stored with the PIN and applied to the paired client.
